checkpoints.description: [1/2] Memoize hashId by normalized relative path for repeated model scans

impact_assessment.benefits: Cold and repeated scans reuse stable ids for the same paths
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter + equivalence test, controlled A/B hash, full npm test and 4/4 strict gates; revert if regression
impact_assessment.risks: contract: same 12-char id per normalized path; dependency: crypto; concurrency: none; state: bounded 4096-entry cache
impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; every model scan recomputed a SHA-1 id for each unchanged file path
